task: Todo 12 - build a tickable Brian2 network service layer around Shiu's model

red_first.notes: Initial red test after adding src to sys.path failed for the missing tickable service module.

implementation.brian2_boundary: Brian2 is imported only by _import_brian2(), fixture(), shiu(), and runtime smoke paths, not at normal package import time.
implementation.fixture_mode: Uses a persistent Brian2 Network with PoissonGroup inputs whose rates are updated before each tick.
implementation.shiu_adapter_mode: TickableBrainNetwork.shiu() loads external/drosophila_brain_model/model.py and calls create_model once, then attaches project-owned sensory PoissonGroup/Synapses inputs.
implementation.per_tick_contract: tick() rejects unknown sensory channels before net.run(), updates channel rates, runs configured tick duration, and returns spike/rate deltas per readout group.
implementation.not_used: Shiu run_exp/run_trial is not called by tickable_network.py or smoke_brain.py.

tests.notes: Brian2 emits third-party pyparsing deprecation warnings; test result is OK.

tests.result: Wrote brain_env.json, summary.json, tickable/summary.json, and tickable/ticks.jsonl.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import digital_fruit_fly.brain.tickable_network as t; print(t.ChannelConfig(name='x', target_indices=(0,), max_rate_hz=1.0).name)"
tests.result: Normal system Python import succeeded without requiring Brian2.

tests.command: pure LOC check for src/digital_fruit_fly/brain/tickable_network.py scripts/smoke_brain.py tests/test_tickable_brain.py

adversarial_qa.malformed_input: Unknown sensory channel raises UnknownSensoryChannelError and leaves tick_index at 0 before Brian2 run.
adversarial_qa.stale_state: TickResult computes deltas from last readout counts; smoke JSONL shows per-tick deltas instead of cumulative counts.
adversarial_qa.dirty_worktree: Workspace was already mostly untracked and external/drosophila_brain_model was dirty before this task; edits stayed inside owned files.
adversarial_qa.hung_long_commands: Required brain_env tests and smoke completed. pgrep/ps process checks are blocked by macOS sandbox process-list restrictions in this harness.
adversarial_qa.flaky_tests: Fixture calls brian2.seed(1); smoke output is deterministic for the configured fixture run.
adversarial_qa.misleading_success_output: Evidence records command exit codes and artifact paths; smoke summary includes tickable.status=ok and exact tick counts.

cleanup.runtime_processes: No long-running Brian2 command sessions remain. Direct process-list verification was blocked: pgrep reported sysmond unavailable and ps was operation-not-permitted.

external_protection.result: Pre-existing external diff remains limited to example.ipynb; this task did not modify external files.

risks_blockers: Full Shiu tick mode is implemented as an adapter constructor but was not run in acceptance smoke; the smoke uses the deterministic fixture mode to avoid multi-minute/full-connectome runtime during Todo 12.
Brian2 emits third-party pyparsing deprecation warnings under brain_env; they do not fail tests.
The fixture mean wall time is slower than a 15 ms realtime budget on this machine (~30 ms/tick), but deterministic per-tick output is produced.
